author: board 23 builder (item induce)
what: the kept programs of reason/induce.mjs: per cue level and pattern, the programs that reproduce at least minSupport development GSM8K records (following the worked chain), ranked; records are the provenance

dsl.name: q
dsl.meaning: extract: the i-th number written in the text (digits, number words, money, percent as a fraction)

dsl.name: f
dsl.meaning: fraction word: half, a third, two-thirds, a quarter, 3/4 written as a fraction (the i-th one)

dsl.name: m
dsl.meaning: multiplier word: twice, double, triple, thrice, quadruple (the i-th one)

dsl.name: dozen
dsl.meaning: 12, present when the text says dozen

dsl.name: week
dsl.meaning: 7 days in a week, present when the text names weeks and days

dsl.name: hour
dsl.meaning: 60 minutes in an hour, present when the text names hours and minutes

dsl.name: minute
dsl.meaning: 60 seconds in a minute, present when the text names minutes and seconds

dsl.name: day
dsl.meaning: 24 hours in a day, present when the text names days and hours

dsl.name: yearm
dsl.meaning: 12 months in a year, present when the text names years and months

dsl.name: yearw
dsl.meaning: 52 weeks in a year, present when the text names years and weeks

dsl.name: monthw
dsl.meaning: 4 weeks in a month, present when the text names months and weeks

dsl.name: pct100
dsl.meaning: 100, present when the text says percent (a whole in percentage points)

dsl.name: two
dsl.meaning: 2, present when the text says both, pair, twins, round trip or couple

dsl.name: add
dsl.meaning: total: a + b (in all, altogether, combined, sum)

dsl.name: sub
dsl.meaning: remaining or compare: a - b (left, how many more, difference)

dsl.name: mul
dsl.meaning: times: a * b (each, per item times items, twice, half of)

dsl.name: div
dsl.meaning: per: a / b (split equally, rate, average, how many groups)

dsl.name: grow
dsl.meaning: a increased by the fraction b: a * (1 + b) (b percent more, a and twice a together)

dsl.name: shrink
dsl.meaning: a decreased by the fraction b: a * (1 - b) (discount, what is left after spending a fraction)

forms.reader: reason/induce.mjs questionForm(question).role: the role-level pattern (quantity count, the question cue classes, the named quantities, every positional quantity's role tag)
forms.what: each entry's forms.roles lists the role-level patterns of the development records it fit (its records); act/prompt.mjs gate 7 answers only a prompt whose form is one of them; added to entries that had none, nothing else changed

devRows.what: the development records the store fits, each [id, role form, leaf table, gold]: act/prompt.mjs refuses a learned entry that would answer one of them wrong (its pattern at the entry level, one of its forms, a value past the invariant that is not the gold)
devRows.reader: reason/induce.mjs parse(question): patterns(p).role and leafTable(p); goldOf(record)

split.wording: the store was fit on these 533 records before board 35 (bench/induce.mjs on bench/verdicts/ns.json rows.development); 438 of them are GSM8K test records outside the 200 development ids of bench/verdicts/math.json (95 inside), so every measure on them is development, never held out
